messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- Ember noticed that search-indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy [observation; valid 2026-02-12 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-02-12]
- Dune owns search-indexer [valid 2025-12-08 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-08-search-indexer]
    earlier: Cinder owns search-indexer [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-12-08; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17-2]
- Cinder noticed that search-indexer's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change [observation; valid 2026-01-01 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-01-01]
- Decision: search-indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every catalog write, because incremental updates left stale entries behind after failed writes [decision; valid 2025-12-17 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-12-17]
- Search-indexer must stay on OpenSearch 2.11 until the full reindex completes [constraint; valid 2025-08-27 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-08-27]
- Dune noticed that search-indexer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send [observation; valid 2025-11-06 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-11-06]
- Decision: the scheduler leader lease will be shortened to ten seconds, because two leaders ran the nightly jobs twice in INC-2026-009 [decision; valid 2026-05-08 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- INC-2025-023: search-indexer served stale results for two days on 2025-10-13; the root cause was a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk [valid 2025-10-16 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- Search-indexer depends on the catalog [valid 2025-02-28 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-02-28]
- The catalog deploys only on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC [constraint; valid 2026-03-16 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-16]
    earlier: The catalog deploys only on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC [constraint; valid 2025-03-24 to 2026-03-16; recorded by standup/dune/2025-03-24]
- Dune noticed that reporting's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy [observation; valid 2026-03-10 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-10-2]
- INC-2026-009: the scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-03; the root cause was two leaders elected during a network partition [valid 2026-05-08 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- The scheduler deploys only on weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC [constraint; valid 2025-10-27 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-10-27-2]
    earlier: The scheduler deploys only on weekdays after 15:00 UTC [constraint; valid 2025-03-19 to 2025-10-27; recorded by standup/ember/2025-03-19]
- Decision: reindex jobs will page on failure, because a silent reindex failure left stale results for two days in INC-2025-023 [decision; valid 2025-10-16 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- Atlas noticed that webhooks's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change [observation; valid 2026-05-25 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-25-2]
- Atlas noticed that the scheduler's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade [observation; valid 2026-03-09 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-03-09-2]
- Ember noticed that the scheduler's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump [observation; valid 2026-03-19 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-19-2]
- No deploys to billing-api from 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02 because of the peak season [constraint; valid 2025-11-04 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-04]
- Dune owns billing-api [valid 2026-05-26 to now; recorded by handover/2026-05-26-billing-api]
    earlier: Boreal owns billing-api [valid 2025-03-17 to 2026-05-26; recorded by handover/2025-03-17-billing-api]
    earlier: Atlas owns billing-api [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-03-17; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08]
- Decision: image-resizer will keep original uploads for 90 days only, because storage for originals doubled in six months [decision; valid 2026-03-03 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-03]

Question: When can search-indexer be deployed?

message.reasoning:
The user asks: "When can search-indexer be deployed?"

Looking at the memory, the constraints are about catalog deploys (Tuesdays 13:00-15:00 UTC), scheduler deploys (weekday mornings before 11:00 UTC), billing-api (no deploys during peak season). There's no constraint about search-indexer deployment times.

There is a constraint about search-indexer staying on OpenSearch 2.11, but nothing about when it can be deployed.

So the answer is "I don't know".
